refs.role: style/material reference only, do not copy grave scenery or gravestone

sourceLore.details: Second Cairn swords have fallen into mud; its stones bear no names. Leave/loot leave swords fallen. Raised variant will change sword state only.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable isolated foreground prop for AshenSpire, on genuine transparent alpha background. Polished hand-painted dark fantasy, weathered tactile surfaces, dark iron, aged brass and restrained ember-warm highlights, same painted language as the reference. Full object visible with generous transparent margins; no hard rectangular backing, background scenery, opaque backdrop, fake checkerboard, labels, lettering, UI, borders, logos, stat values, map coordinates or characters. Maintain clear silhouette readable on mobile. Do not add unrelated props.
Primary request: Square canvas: a low cairn of piled rough weathered grey stones with absolutely no carved names or symbols, resting on one small irregular oval patch of dark roadside mud. EXACTLY five old worn straight iron swords with simple aged brass guards lie fallen in the mud around the cairn, all five individually readable. No swords stand upright. Cairn and mud footprint occupy the lower half; keep upper 45 percent empty transparent space for a future matching upright-swords state. Three-quarter slightly elevated camera, neutral cool fill with restrained warm rim light. No gravestone inscription, candle, bell, skull, keeper or person.
